title: reforged-ts rename map
description: Every public symbol a major version removed or renamed, with its replacement. The migration guide and the legacy-names lint rule are generated from it.

symbol.description: A class, or a class-qualified static or instance member, as an author writes it; `(...)` marks a call.

version.description: A package and its major version.

old.description: The symbol as an author of the `from` version wrote it: `new Unit(...)`, `Group.getEnumUnit`, `Frame.parent`, `hookedMain`; or an entry point of `addScriptHook` as its `W3TS_HOOK` value reads, `main::before`.

new.description: The replacement as the author will write it; several when the old symbol splits (a get/set pair, overloads mapped by argument shape); null when there is none.

kind.description: What the old symbol is. An `entryPoint` is one of the four entry points of `addScriptHook` (`main::before`, `main::after`, `config::before`, `config::after`); its replacement, when there is one, is the Init stage at the same moment or the closest later one.

versions.description: The major versions the entry applies between.

oneToOne.description: Whether the rewrite is mechanical: replacing the old symbol with the new one keeps the arguments. The lint rule autofixes only these.

note.description: Why the symbol changed, in one sentence.
